name: zarchive_list_get_count
description: zArchiveList::GetCount returns zero for a null archive list and otherwise returns the list count field.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48cc60 validates the __fastcall ECX=list ABI, null-list zero return, and direct return of list->count for non-null lists.
The native smoke verifies both the null-list zero return and a non-null list count return.
